title: A Special Relativistic Model of Mind and Artificial Intelligence: One Cone with Ten Properties
content: John Searle argues that if one claims that he is talking about mind, four things must be discussed: Subjectivity, causality, intentionality, and consciousness. Here we consider rationality as a major indicator of subjectivity. In artificial intelligence, we assume as our working hypothesis that mind can be embodied in artificial intelligence; call it artificial mind. Our previous work discussed artificial consciousness. In this paper, we will have a complete discussion of the four properties and rationality from an artificial intelligence perspective. A special relativistic model of mind as well as rationality and artificial intelligence are formulated. The model is based the geometric characters of light cone, which characterizes ten properties as follows: consciousness, intentionality, causality, subjectivity, individualized proper strong momentum as well as proper weak momentum, economic rationality, bounded rationality, ordinary rationality, and agents who are left out of the social cone.
